RAHUL SHARMA
Email: rahul.sharma@example.com
Phone: +91-9876543210
Location: Bangalore, India

SUMMARY
Senior Backend Engineer with 6 years of experience building scalable
payment and transaction systems. Specialized in Python microservices,
PostgreSQL optimization, and AWS-native architectures.

EXPERIENCE

Senior Backend Engineer — PayFlow Systems (2021 - Present, 3.5 years)
- Led the design and rollout of a new payment processing microservice
  handling 2M+ transactions per day using Python and FastAPI.
- Reduced p99 latency from 480ms to 120ms by optimizing PostgreSQL
  queries and adding Redis-backed caching.
- Architected event-driven pipeline on AWS (SQS, Lambda, RDS) reducing
  infrastructure cost by 35%.
- Mentored a team of 5 engineers and conducted 200+ code reviews.
- Deployed all services on Docker with ECS; introduced blue-green deploys.

Backend Engineer — FinEdge Technologies (2019 - 2021, 2 years)
- Built REST APIs for merchant onboarding using Django REST Framework.
- Designed PostgreSQL schemas for high-volume ledger data.
- Integrated third-party payment gateways (Razorpay, Stripe).
- Wrote integration tests achieving 85% coverage.

Software Engineer Intern — Zeta Systems (2018 - 2019, 1 year)
- Contributed to internal billing service in Python.
- Wrote data migration scripts for PostgreSQL.

PROJECTS
- OpenLedger: Open-source double-entry ledger in Python (400+ GitHub stars).
- PayKit: Lightweight Python SDK for payment gateway integrations.

SKILLS
Python, FastAPI, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda,
SQS), Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Git, CI/CD, Distributed Systems.

EDUCATION
B.Tech in Computer Science — NIT Trichy, 2018
